```sql
-- Step 1: Identify the New York Central Park weather station by its WBAN
WITH central_park_station AS (
    SELECT
        s."wban"
    FROM
        NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1.NOAA_GSOD.STATIONS s
    WHERE
        LOWER(s."name") LIKE '%central park%'
        AND LOWER(s."name") LIKE '%new york%'
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Step 2: Find all Citibike stations located within zip code 10019
-- Use ST_GEOGFROMWKB directly which returns GEOGRAPHY type
stations_in_10019 AS (
    SELECT
        cs."station_id"
    FROM
        NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1.NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE.CITIBIKE_STATIONS cs
    WHERE
        ST_WITHIN(
            ST_GEOMPOINT(cs."longitude", cs."latitude"),
            (SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB(z."zip_code_geom") 
             FROM NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1.GEO_US_BOUNDARIES.ZIP_CODES z 
             WHERE z."zip_code" = '10019' AND z."state_code" = 'NY')
        )
),

-- Step 3: Filter trips that start and end in 10019 during 2018
trips_2018_10019 AS (
    SELECT
        ct."usertype",
        DATE_PART('year', TO_TIMESTAMP(ct."starttime" / 1000000)) AS trip_year,
        DATE_PART('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(ct."starttime" / 1000000)) AS trip_month,
        DATE_PART('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(ct."starttime" / 1000000)) AS trip_day
    FROM
        NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1.NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE.CITIBIKE_TRIPS ct
    WHERE
        ct."start_station_id" IN (SELECT "station_id" FROM stations_in_10019)
        AND ct."end_station_id" IN (SELECT "station_id" FROM stations_in_10019)
        AND DATE_PART('year', TO_TIMESTAMP(ct."starttime" / 1000000)) = 2018
),

-- Step 4: Weather data from Central Park station for 2018 (excluding missing values)
weather_2018 AS (
    SELECT
        w."year",
        w."mo",
        w."da",
        w."temp",
        w."prcp",
        CAST(w."wdsp" AS FLOAT) AS wind_speed
    FROM
        NEW_YORK_CITIBIKE_1.NOAA_GSOD.GSOD2018 w
    WHERE
        w."wban" = (SELECT "wban" FROM central_park_station)
        AND w."temp" < 9999.9
        AND w."prcp" < 99.99
        AND CAST(w."wdsp" AS FLOAT) < 999.9
),

-- Step 5: Join trips with weather on date and aggregate by user type
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        t."usertype",
        ROUND(AVG(wh."temp"), 4) AS avg_temperature,
        ROUND(AVG(wh."prcp"), 4) AS avg_precipitation,
        ROUND(AVG(wh."wind_speed"), 4) AS avg_wind_speed
    FROM
        trips_2018_10019 t
        JOIN weather_2018 wh
            ON t."trip_year" = CAST(wh."year" AS INTEGER)
            AND t."trip_month" = CAST(wh."mo" AS INTEGER)
            AND t."trip_day" = CAST(wh."da" AS INTEGER)
    GROUP BY
        t."usertype"
)

-- Step 6: Return the user type with the highest average temperature
SELECT
    a."usertype",
    a."avg_temperature",
    a."avg_precipitation",
    a."avg_wind_speed"
FROM
    aggregated a
ORDER BY
    a."avg_temperature" DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
-- Define the center point (lat=26.75, lon=51.5) as GEOGRAPHY
center_point AS (
    SELECT ST_GEOGRAPHYFROMWKT('POINT(51.5 26.75)') AS "center_geo"
),
-- Filter forecasts spatially and by creation date
filtered_forecasts AS (
    SELECT 
        f."creation_time",
        f."geography",
        DATEADD('second', f."creation_time" / 1000000, '1970-01-01')::DATE AS "creation_date",
        f."forecast"
    FROM 
        "NOAA_GLOBAL_FORECAST_SYSTEM"."NOAA_GLOBAL_FORECAST_SYSTEM"."NOAA_GFS0P25" f,
        center_point c
    WHERE 
        ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMWKB(f."geography"), c."center_geo") <= 5000
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATEADD('second', f."creation_time" / 1000000, '1970-01-01')) = 2019
        AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATEADD('second', f."creation_time" / 1000000, '1970-01-01')) = 7
),
-- Flatten the forecast array into hourly records for the next day
flattened_hours AS (
    SELECT 
        ff."creation_date",
        DATEADD('second', h.value:"time"::NUMBER / 1000000, '1970-01-01')::DATE AS "forecast_date",
        EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(h.value:"time"::NUMBER / 1000000)) AS "forecast_hour",
        h.value:"temperature_2m_above_ground"::FLOAT AS "temperature",
        h.value:"total_precipitation_surface"::FLOAT AS "precipitation",
        h.value:"total_cloud_cover_entire_atmosphere"::FLOAT AS "cloud_cover"
    FROM 
        filtered_forecasts ff,
        LATERAL FLATTEN(input => ff."forecast") h
    WHERE 
        -- Only keep forecast hours for the next day (forecast_date = creation_date + 1)
        DATEADD('second', h.value:"time"::NUMBER / 1000000, '1970-01-01')::DATE = DATEADD('day', 1, ff."creation_date")
),
-- Compute daily average temperature to classify precipitation type
daily_avg_temp AS (
    SELECT 
        fh."forecast_date",
        AVG(fh."temperature") AS "daily_avg_temp"
    FROM 
        flattened_hours fh
    GROUP BY 
        fh."forecast_date"
),
-- Daily aggregates with correct conditional sums using the precomputed average
daily_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        fh."forecast_date",
        ROUND(MAX(fh."temperature"), 4) AS "max_temperature",
        ROUND(MIN(fh."temperature"), 4) AS "min_temperature",
        ROUND(AVG(fh."temperature"), 4) AS "avg_temperature",
        ROUND(SUM(fh."precipitation"), 4) AS "total_precipitation",
        ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fh."forecast_hour" BETWEEN 10 AND 17 THEN fh."cloud_cover" END), 4) AS "avg_cloud_cover_10_17",
        -- Snowfall: sum precipitation when daily average temperature < 0�C (32�F)
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dat."daily_avg_temp" < 0 THEN fh."precipitation" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "total_snowfall",
        -- Rainfall: sum precipitation when daily average temperature >= 0�C
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dat."daily_avg_temp" >= 0 THEN fh."precipitation" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "total_rainfall"
    FROM 
        flattened_hours fh
    JOIN 
        daily_avg_temp dat ON fh."forecast_date" = dat."forecast_date"
    GROUP BY 
        fh."forecast_date"
)
-- Final selection
SELECT 
    da."forecast_date",
    da."max_temperature",
    da."min_temperature",
    da."avg_temperature",
    da."total_precipitation",
    da."avg_cloud_cover_10_17",
    da."total_snowfall",
    da."total_rainfall"
FROM 
    daily_agg da
ORDER BY 
    da."forecast_date";
```
</details>

```sql
WITH

),

-- Find all NOAA weather stations within 20 miles of Chappaqua
```

<details open>
<summary><b>Baseline Execution Result (❌)</b></summary>

</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
  -- Daily wind speed at JFK station (744860) from 2011 to 2020
  daily_wind AS (
    SELECT
      date,
      MIN(SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)) AS wind_speed
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
      AND stn = '744860'
      AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
      AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
    GROUP BY
      date
  ),

  -- Daily complaint counts per type from 311 service requests
  daily_complaints AS (
    SELECT
      DATE(created_date) AS date,
      complaint_type,
      COUNT(*) AS type_count
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
    WHERE
      created_date >= '2011-01-01'
      AND created_date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY
      date,
      complaint_type
  ),

  -- Total number of complaints per day
  daily_total AS (
    SELECT
      date,
      SUM(type_count) AS total_complaints
    FROM
      daily_complaints
    GROUP BY
      date
  ),

  -- Daily proportion of each complaint type
  daily_proportions AS (
    SELECT
      dc.date,
      dc.complaint_type,
      dc.type_count / dt.total_complaints AS proportion
    FROM
      daily_complaints dc
      JOIN daily_total dt ON dc.date = dt.date
    WHERE
      dt.total_complaints > 0
  ),

  -- Complaint types that have more than 3000 total requests
  top_types AS (
    SELECT
      complaint_type
    FROM
      daily_complaints
    GROUP BY
      complaint_type
    HAVING
      SUM(type_count) > 3000
  ),

  -- Pearson correlation coefficients for each qualifying complaint type
  correlations AS (
    SELECT
      dp.complaint_type,
      ROUND(CORR(dp.proportion, dw.wind_speed), 4) AS corr
    FROM
      daily_proportions dp
      JOIN daily_wind dw ON dp.date = dw.date
    WHERE
      dp.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM top_types)
    GROUP BY
      dp.complaint_type
    HAVING
      corr IS NOT NULL
  ),

  -- Rank correlations to find strongest positive and strongest negative
  ranked AS (
    SELECT
      complaint_type,
      corr,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY corr DESC) AS rn_pos,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY corr ASC) AS rn_neg
    FROM
      correlations
  )

-- Output the two strongest correlations (one positive, one negative)
SELECT
  complaint_type,
  corr
FROM
  ranked
WHERE
  rn_pos = 1 OR rn_neg = 1
ORDER BY
  corr DESC;
```
</details>

### 43. bq293 (DB: `new_york_geo`)
**Question**: I want to analyze New York City yellow taxi trip data specifically for January 1, 2015, using the bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015 dataset. I need to join this with the geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes table to map each trip to its respective NYC zip code based on the pickup coordinates. The analysis should create a complete hour-by-hour breakdown for all zip codes by cross-joining distinct zip codes with distinct hours, including hours with zero trips. For each zip code and hour combination, calculate the total number of trips and the following time-based metrics: count of trips from 1 hour ago, 1 day (24 hours) ago, 7 days (168 hours) ago, and 14 days (336 hours) ago. Additionally, compute the 14-day and 21-day moving averages and standard deviations of trip counts, excluding the current hour. Only include trips with valid latitude and longitude coordinates. The final results should be sorted by the highest trip counts, showing only the top 5 groups with the most trips.

**Status**: Baseline ❌ | SlayQL ❌

#### 📊 Execution Results Comparison

|-----------:|--------------:|-------------:|---------------:|----------------:|-----------------:|-----------------:|-------------------:|----------------------:|-------------------:|
|      10016 |             1 |         2017 |           1730 |             nan |              nan |              nan |             1730   |                nan    |             1730   |
|      10003 |             0 |         1801 |            nan |             nan |              nan |              nan |              nan   |                nan    |              nan   |
|      10016 |             2 |         1758 |           2017 |             nan |              nan |              nan |             1873.5 |                202.94 |             1873.5 |
|      10022 |             1 |         1731 |           1440 |             nan |              nan |              nan |             1440   |                nan    |             1440   |

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Define the set of NYC zip codes (within New York City counties)
WITH nyc_zip_codes AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
    AND county IN ('New York County', 'Kings County', 'Queens County', 'Bronx County', 'Richmond County')
),

-- Step 2: Map each valid trip to its zip code and truncate pickup time to hour.
-- Include only trips from Dec 11, 2014 to Jan 1, 2015 to cover all needed look-back periods.
trip_zip AS (
  SELECT
    z.zip_code,
    TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(t.pickup_datetime, HOUR) AS hour_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN nyc_zip_codes z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE
    t.pickup_datetime IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude != 0
    AND t.pickup_longitude != 0
    AND t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2014-12-11 00:00:00')  -- 21 days before Jan 1, 2015
    AND t.pickup_datetime <  TIMESTAMP('2015-01-02 00:00:00') -- include all of Jan 1
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour_bucket
),

-- Step 3: Generate a complete grid of all NYC zip codes × all hours in the look-back period.
-- This ensures zero counts for missing hours.
hour_grid AS (
  SELECT hour_bucket
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(
    '2014-12-11 00:00:00',
    '2015-01-01 23:00:00',
    INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  )) AS hour_bucket
),

all_zip_hours AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour_bucket
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM nyc_zip_codes) z
  CROSS JOIN hour_grid h
),

-- Step 4: Fill in trip counts (NULL becomes 0)
full_grid AS (
  SELECT
    a.zip_code,
    a.hour_bucket,
    COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) AS trip_count
  FROM all_zip_hours a
  LEFT JOIN trip_zip t
    ON a.zip_code = t.zip_code
    AND a.hour_bucket = t.hour_bucket
)

-- Step 5: From the full grid, calculate all required metrics for each hour on January 1, 2015.
SELECT
  zip_code,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_bucket) AS hour_of_day,
  trip_count,
  -- Time-based lags (using windowed LAG)
  LAG(trip_count, 1)  OVER (PARTITION BY zip_code ORDER BY hour_bucket) AS count_1h_ago,
  LAG(trip_count, 24) OVER (PARTITION BY zip_code ORDER BY hour_bucket) AS count_24h_ago,
  LAG(trip_count, 168) OVER (PARTITION BY zip_code ORDER BY hour_bucket) AS count_168h_ago,
  LAG(trip_count, 336) OVER (PARTITION BY zip_code ORDER BY hour_bucket) AS count_336h_ago,
  -- 14-day moving average and stddev (excluding current hour)
  AVG(trip_count) OVER (
    PARTITION BY zip_code
    ORDER BY hour_bucket
    ROWS BETWEEN 336 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
  ) AS moving_avg_14day,
  STDDEV(trip_count) OVER (
    PARTITION BY zip_code
    ORDER BY hour_bucket
    ROWS BETWEEN 336 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
  ) AS moving_stddev_14day,
  -- 21-day moving average and stddev (excluding current hour)
  AVG(trip_count) OVER (
    PARTITION BY zip_code
    ORDER BY hour_bucket
    ROWS BETWEEN 504 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
  ) AS moving_avg_21day,
  STDDEV(trip_count) OVER (
    PARTITION BY zip_code
    ORDER BY hour_bucket
    ROWS BETWEEN 504 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
  ) AS moving_stddev_21day
FROM full_grid
WHERE
  hour_bucket >= TIMESTAMP('2015-01-01 00:00:00')
  AND hour_bucket <= TIMESTAMP('2015-01-01 23:00:00')
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
</details>

```sql
    FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."ZIP_CODES_2018_5YR"
```

```sql
-- Step 1: Extract 2017 tract data using available columns
WITH tract_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        "geo_id",
        "not_in_labor_force",
        "pop_in_labor_force",
        "unemployed_pop",          -- assumed column (may need adjustment)
        "group_quarters",          -- assumed column
        "median_income" AS "median_income_2017"  -- assumed column
    FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2017_5YR"
),

-- Step 2: Extract 2015 tract median income
tract_2015 AS (
    SELECT 
        "geo_id",
        "median_income" AS "median_income_2015"
    FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2015_5YR"
),

-- Step 3: Extract 2018 tract median income
tract_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        "geo_id",
        "median_income" AS "median_income_2018"
    FROM "CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS_2"."CENSUS_BUREAU_ACS"."CENSUSTRACT_2018_5YR"
),

-- Step 4: Join tracts, compute total population from available columns
tract_combined AS (
    SELECT 
        t17."geo_id",
        t17."unemployed_pop",
        t17."not_in_labor_force",
        t17."group_quarters",
        (t17."pop_in_labor_force" + t17."not_in_labor_force") AS "total_population",
        t15."median_income_2015",
        t18."median_income_2018"
    FROM tract_2017 t17
    INNER JOIN tract_2015 t15 ON t17."geo_id" = t15."geo_id"
    INNER JOIN tract_2018 t18 ON t17."geo_id" = t18."geo_id"
    WHERE t15."median_income_2015" IS NOT NULL
      AND t18."median_income_2018" IS NOT NULL
),

-- Step 5: Compute adjusted non-labor force (clamped to zero), income difference, state FIPS prefix
tract_adjusted AS (
    SELECT 
        "geo_id",
        LEFT("geo_id", 2) AS "state_fips",
        GREATEST("unemployed_pop" + "not_in_labor_force" - "group_quarters", 0) AS "adjusted_non_labor",
        "total_population",
        ("median_income_2018" - "median_income_2015") AS "income_diff"
    FROM tract_combined
)

-- Step 6: Aggregate at state level using state FIPS code (abbreviation not available)
SELECT 
    t."state_fips" AS "state_code",
    SUM(t."income_diff") AS "total_median_income_change",
    SUM(t."adjusted_non_labor") AS "total_adjusted_non_labor_population",
    ROUND(AVG(t."adjusted_non_labor" / NULLIF(t."total_population", 0)), 4) AS "avg_population_adjusted_proportion"
FROM tract_adjusted t
GROUP BY t."state_fips"
ORDER BY "total_adjusted_non_labor_population" ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

The relation should have a specified name and no 'wikidata' tag, and at least one of its included features must have a 'wikidata' tag. The analysis should be conducted using the planet_features table. Return the name of this relation.

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Get the geometry of the multipolygon tagged with wikidata Q1095
WITH q1095_geom AS (
    SELECT ST_GEOGFROMWKB(f."geometry") AS geom
    FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" f,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => f."all_tags") t
    WHERE t.value:"key"::STRING = 'wikidata'
      AND t.value:"value"::STRING = 'Q1095'
    ORDER BY f."feature_type" = 'multipolygons' DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Step 2: All features that intersect the Q1095 area
features_in_q1095 AS (
    SELECT f."osm_id",
           f."osm_way_id",
           f."geometry",
           f."all_tags",
           ST_GEOGFROMWKB(f."geometry") AS geo
    FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" f
    WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMWKB(f."geometry"), (SELECT geom FROM q1095_geom))
),

-- Step 3: Get all relations and their tags in a flattened form
relation_tags AS (
    SELECT f."osm_id",
           f."geometry",
           f."all_tags",
           ST_GEOGFROMWKB(f."geometry") AS "geo_relation",
           t.value:"key"::STRING AS "tag_key",
           t.value:"value"::STRING AS "tag_value"
    FROM "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_FEATURES" f,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => f."all_tags") t
    WHERE f."osm_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMWKB(f."geometry"), (SELECT geom FROM q1095_geom))
),

-- Step 4: Filter relations that have a name but no wikidata tag
valid_relations AS (
    SELECT rt."osm_id",
           rt."geometry",
           rt."all_tags",
           rt."geo_relation"
    FROM relation_tags rt
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM relation_tags rt2 
        WHERE rt2."osm_id" = rt."osm_id" AND rt2."tag_key" = 'name'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM relation_tags rt2 
        WHERE rt2."osm_id" = rt."osm_id" AND rt2."tag_key" = 'wikidata'
    )
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rt."osm_id" ORDER BY rt."tag_key") = 1
),

-- Step 5: Get relation names
relation_names AS (
    SELECT rt."osm_id",
           rt."geo_relation",
           rt."tag_value" AS "relation_name"
    FROM relation_tags rt
    WHERE rt."tag_key" = 'name'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM relation_tags rt2 
        WHERE rt2."osm_id" = rt."osm_id" AND rt2."tag_key" = 'name'
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM relation_tags rt2 
        WHERE rt2."osm_id" = rt."osm_id" AND rt2."tag_key" = 'wikidata'
    )
),

-- Step 6: For each relation, count how many features from features_in_q1095 are contained within it
contained_features AS (
    SELECT rn."relation_name",
           f2."osm_id" AS "feature_id",
           f2."all_tags" AS "feature_tags"
    FROM relation_names rn
    JOIN features_in_q1095 f2
        ON ST_WITHIN(f2.geo, rn."geo_relation")
),

-- Step 7: Filter relations that have at least one contained feature with wikidata tag
contained_with_wikidata AS (
    SELECT cf."relation_name"
    FROM contained_features cf,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => cf."feature_tags") t
    WHERE t.value:"key"::STRING = 'wikidata'
),

-- Step 8: Count features per relation
feature_counts AS (
    SELECT cf."relation_name",
           COUNT(*) AS "feature_count"
    FROM contained_features cf
    WHERE cf."relation_name" IN (SELECT "relation_name" FROM contained_with_wikidata)
    GROUP BY cf."relation_name"
)

-- Step 9: Return the name of the relation with the highest count
SELECT fc."relation_name" AS name
FROM feature_counts fc
ORDER BY fc."feature_count" DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
</details>

```sql
      AND p."osm_way_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND ST_WITHIN(TO_GEOGRAPHY(p."geometry"), ref_mp."ref_geom")
      AND p."osm_way_id" NOT IN (SELECT "id" FROM mp_with_wikidata)
),

-- Step 4: Count nodes inside each candidate multipolygon
point_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c."id",
        c."all_tags",
        COUNT(*) AS "point_count"
    FROM candidate_mp c
    INNER JOIN "GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."GEO_OPENSTREETMAP"."PLANET_NODES" n
        ON ST_WITHIN(ST_MAKEPOINT(n."longitude", n."latitude"), c."geom")
    GROUP BY c."id", c."all_tags"
),

-- Step 5: Extract name from all_tags and rank
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT f2.value:"value"::STRING
             FROM LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => pc."all_tags") f2
             WHERE f2.value:"key" = 'name'
             LIMIT 1),
            'Unnamed'
        ) AS "name",
        pc."point_count",
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc."point_count" DESC) AS "rank"
    FROM point_counts pc
)

-- Step 6: Return top 2
SELECT "name", "point_count"
FROM ranked
WHERE "rank" <= 2
ORDER BY "point_count" DESC;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Get USDC transactions for 2023 from TRANSACTIONS table
usdc_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        tx."block_timestamp",
        tx."input",
        tx."from_address",
        tx."to_address"
    FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_ETHEREUM.TRANSACTIONS tx
    WHERE tx."to_address" = LOWER('0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48')
        AND tx."block_timestamp" >= 1672531200000000  -- 2023-01-01 00:00:00 UTC in microseconds
        AND tx."block_timestamp" <  1704067200000000  -- 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC in microseconds
        AND (tx."input" LIKE '0x40c10f19%' OR tx."input" LIKE '0x42966c68%')
),

-- Step 2: Identify mint/burn operations and extract amounts
filtered_operations AS (
    SELECT 
        TO_TIMESTAMP(tx."block_timestamp" / 1000000) AS "transaction_date",
        tx."input",
        CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 1, 10)) = '0x40c10f19' THEN 1   -- mint
            WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 1, 10)) = '0x42966c68' THEN -1 -- burn
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "operation_type",
        CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 1, 10)) = '0x40c10f19' THEN 
                -- Mint: extract from position 75 (1-indexed), 64 hex chars
                TRY_CAST(
                    CONCAT('0x', LTRIM(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 75, 64), '0'))
                    AS FLOAT
                )
            WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 1, 10)) = '0x42966c68' THEN 
                -- Burn: extract from position 11 (1-indexed), 64 hex chars
                TRY_CAST(
                    CONCAT('0x', LTRIM(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 11, 64), '0'))
                    AS FLOAT
                )
        END AS "amount_raw"
    FROM usdc_transactions tx
    WHERE LOWER(SUBSTRING(tx."input", 1, 10)) IN ('0x40c10f19', '0x42966c68')
),

-- Step 3: Calculate daily net change in millions of USDC
daily_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        "transaction_date"::DATE AS "Date",
        ROUND(
            SUM(
                "operation_type" * 
                COALESCE("amount_raw" / 1000000.0, 0)  -- Convert to USDC (6 decimals)
            ) / 1000000.0,  -- Convert to millions
            2
        ) AS "change_in_millions"
    FROM filtered_operations
    WHERE "amount_raw" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "transaction_date"::DATE
)

-- Step 4: Final output in USD format
SELECT 
    "Date",
    '$' || TO_VARCHAR("change_in_millions", 'FM999999999.00') || 'M' AS "Daily Market Value Change"
FROM daily_changes
ORDER BY "Date" DESC;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Get blocks before September 1, 2021
blocks_before_date AS (
    SELECT "number"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."BLOCKS"
    WHERE "timestamp" < 1630447200
),

-- Get successful transactions before the cutoff date
filtered_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        tx."from_address",
        tx."to_address",
        tx."value",
        tx."receipt_gas_used",
        tx."receipt_effective_gas_price",
        tx."block_number",
        tx."transaction_index"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRANSACTIONS" tx
    INNER JOIN blocks_before_date b 
        ON tx."block_number" = b."number"
    WHERE tx."receipt_status" = 1
),

-- Get valid traces with call_type filter
valid_traces AS (
    SELECT 
        t."transaction_index",
        t."block_number",
        t."to_address",
        t."from_address",
        t."value"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRACES" t
    WHERE 
        t."status" = 1
        AND (t."call_type" IS NULL OR t."call_type" = 'call')
),

-- Calculate balance changes per address from transactions
balance_from_tx AS (
    SELECT 
        "from_address" AS "address",
        -SUM(COALESCE("value", 0) + COALESCE("receipt_gas_used", 0) * COALESCE("receipt_effective_gas_price", 0)) AS "net_change"
    FROM filtered_transactions
    WHERE "from_address" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "from_address"
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        "to_address" AS "address",
        SUM(COALESCE("value", 0)) AS "net_change"
    FROM filtered_transactions
    WHERE "to_address" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "to_address"
),

-- Calculate balance changes from traces
balance_from_traces AS (
    SELECT 
        "from_address" AS "address",
        -SUM(COALESCE("value", 0)) AS "net_change"
    FROM valid_traces
    WHERE "from_address" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "from_address"
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        "to_address" AS "address",
        SUM(COALESCE("value", 0)) AS "net_change"
    FROM valid_traces
    WHERE "to_address" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "to_address"
),

-- Combine all balance changes
all_balance_changes AS (
    SELECT * FROM balance_from_tx
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM balance_from_traces
),

-- Aggregate per address
aggregated_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        "address",
        SUM("net_change") AS "net_balance"
    FROM all_balance_changes
    GROUP BY "address"
)

-- Get top 10 addresses by net balance
SELECT 
    "address",
    ROUND("net_balance", 4) AS "net_balance"
FROM aggregated_balances
ORDER BY "net_balance" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH top_address AS (
    SELECT "from_address" AS "addr"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRANSACTIONS"
    WHERE "receipt_status" = 1
      AND "block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000
    GROUP BY "from_address"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
incoming_tx AS (
    SELECT "to_address" AS "addr", SUM("value") AS "sum_in"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRANSACTIONS" t
    INNER JOIN top_address a ON t."to_address" = a."addr"
    WHERE t."receipt_status" = 1
      AND t."block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000
    GROUP BY t."to_address"
),
incoming_traces AS (
    SELECT "to_address" AS "addr", SUM("value") AS "sum_in"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRACES" r
    INNER JOIN top_address a ON r."to_address" = a."addr"
    WHERE r."status" = 1
      AND r."block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000
      AND (r."call_type" IS NULL OR r."call_type" NOT IN ('delegatecall','callcode','staticcall'))
    GROUP BY r."to_address"
),
outgoing_tx_value AS (
    SELECT "from_address" AS "addr", SUM("value") AS "sum_out_value"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRANSACTIONS" t
    INNER JOIN top_address a ON t."from_address" = a."addr"
    WHERE t."receipt_status" = 1
      AND t."block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000
    GROUP BY t."from_address"
),
outgoing_gas AS (
    SELECT "from_address" AS "addr", SUM("receipt_gas_used" * "receipt_effective_gas_price") AS "sum_gas"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TRANSACTIONS" t
    INNER JOIN top_address a ON t."from_address" = a."addr"
    WHERE t."block_timestamp" < 1630454400000000
    GROUP BY t."from_address"
)
SELECT 
    a."addr",
    ROUND(
        (COALESCE(itx."sum_in", 0) + COALESCE(itr."sum_in", 0) - COALESCE(otx."sum_out_value", 0) - COALESCE(og."sum_gas", 0)) / 1e18,
        4
    ) AS "final_balance_ether"
FROM top_address a
LEFT JOIN incoming_tx itx ON a."addr" = itx."addr"
LEFT JOIN incoming_traces itr ON a."addr" = itr."addr"
LEFT JOIN outgoing_tx_value otx ON a."addr" = otx."addr"
LEFT JOIN outgoing_gas og ON a."addr" = og."addr";
```

```sql
-- Step 1: Filter transfers for the specific token and sender/receiver criteria, within the date range
WITH filtered_transfers AS (
    SELECT
        t."block_timestamp",
        t."from_address",
        t."to_address",
        TRY_CAST(t."value" AS NUMBER) AS "value_num"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS" t
    WHERE t."token_address" = '0x68e54af74b22acaccffa04ccaad13be16ed14eac'
      AND (
          t."from_address" = '0x8babf0ba311aab914c00e8fda7e8558a8b66de5d'
          OR t."to_address" = '0xfbd6c6b112214d949dcdfb1217153bc0a742862f'
      )
      -- Microsecond timestamps for 2019-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and 2020-12-31 23:59:59 UTC
      AND t."block_timestamp" BETWEEN 1546300800000000 AND 1609459199000000
),

-- Step 2: Aggregate by hour and year
hourly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', TO_TIMESTAMP(ft."block_timestamp" / 1000000)) AS "hour",
        SUM(ft."value_num") AS "hourly_total",
        YEAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(ft."block_timestamp" / 1000000)) AS "year"
    FROM filtered_transfers ft
    GROUP BY "hour", "year"
),

-- Step 3: Compute average hourly total per year
yearly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ht."year",
        AVG(ht."hourly_total") AS "avg_hourly_value"
    FROM hourly_totals ht
    GROUP BY ht."year"
)

-- Step 4: Compute the difference between 2020 and 2019 averages
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SELECT "avg_hourly_value" FROM yearly_avg WHERE "year" = 2020)
        - (SELECT "avg_hourly_value" FROM yearly_avg WHERE "year" = 2019),
        4
    ) AS "difference_avg_hourly_value";
```

```sql
WITH token_txns AS (
    SELECT
        "token_address",
        "block_number",
        "from_address",
        "to_address",
        CAST("value" AS DOUBLE) AS "value"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS"
    WHERE "token_address" IN (
        '0x0d8775f648430679a709e98d2b0cb6250d2887ef0',
        '0x1e15c05cbad367f044cbfbafda3d9a1510db5513'
    )
),
median_blocks AS (
    SELECT
        "token_address",
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "block_number") AS "median_block"
    FROM token_txns
    GROUP BY "token_address"
),
address_balances AS (
    SELECT
        t."token_address",
        t."address",
        SUM(CASE WHEN t."type" = 'credit' THEN t."value" ELSE -t."value" END) AS "balance"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            "token_address",
            "to_address" AS "address",
            'credit' AS "type",
            "value",
            "block_number"
        FROM token_txns
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            "token_address",
            "from_address" AS "address",
            'debit' AS "type",
            "value",
            "block_number"
        FROM token_txns
    ) t
    GROUP BY t."token_address", t."address"
),
previous_current AS (
    SELECT
        t."token_address",
        t."address",
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t."block_number" < m."median_block" THEN 
            CASE WHEN t."type" = 'credit' THEN t."value" ELSE -t."value" END 
        END), 0) AS "prev_balance",
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t."block_number" >= m."median_block" THEN 
            CASE WHEN t."type" = 'credit' THEN t."value" ELSE -t."value" END 
        END), 0) AS "curr_balance"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            "token_address",
            "to_address" AS "address",
            'credit' AS "type",
            "value",
            "block_number"
        FROM token_txns
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            "token_address",
            "from_address" AS "address",
            'debit' AS "type",
            "value",
            "block_number"
        FROM token_txns
    ) t
    JOIN median_blocks m ON t."token_address" = m."token_address"
    GROUP BY t."token_address", t."address"
),
total_diff AS (
    SELECT
        "address",
        SUM(ABS("curr_balance" - "prev_balance")) AS "abs_diff"
    FROM previous_current
    GROUP BY "address"
)
SELECT
    "address",
    ROUND("abs_diff", 4) AS "absolute_difference"
FROM total_diff
WHERE "address" != '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
ORDER BY "abs_diff" DESC
LIMIT 6;
```
</details>

```sql
    ROUND(AVG((nxt."timestamp" - curr."timestamp") / 1000000.0), 4) AS avg_interval_seconds
FROM numbered_blocks curr
JOIN numbered_blocks nxt
    ON curr.rn = nxt.rn - 1
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(curr."timestamp" / 1000000))
ORDER BY block_date
LIMIT 10;
```

### 59. sf_bq057 (DB: `CRYPTO`)
**Question**: Which month (e.g., 3 for March) in 2021 witnessed the highest percentage of Bitcoin transaction volume occurring in CoinJoin transactions (defined as transactions with >2 outputs, output value ≤ input value, and having multiple equal-value outputs)? Also provide the percentage of all Bitcoin transactions that were CoinJoins, the percentage of UTXOs involved in CoinJoin transactions (average of input and output percentages), and the percentage of total Bitcoin volume that occurred in CoinJoin transactions for that month. Round all percentages to 1 decimal place.

**Status**: Baseline ❌ | SlayQL ❌

#### 📊 Execution Results Comparison

<details open>
<summary><b>Gold Standard Result (Expected)</b></summary>

|   month |   pct_tx_coinjoin |   pct_utxos_coinjoin |   pct_volume_coinjoin |

<summary><b>SlayQL Execution Result (❌)</b></summary>

|--------:|-------------------:|------------:|-------------:|
|      12 |                1.7 |        13.3 |          5.1 |

</details>

<details open>
<summary><b>Baseline Execution Result (❌)</b></summary>

</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH t2021 AS (
    SELECT
        "hash",
        "output_count",
        "input_count",
        "output_value",
        "input_value",
        "outputs",
        "block_timestamp_month" AS "month"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BITCOIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "block_timestamp_month") = 2021
),

-- Flatten outputs to get individual output values
flattened AS (
    SELECT
        t."hash",
        f.value:"value"::NUMBER AS "output_val"
    FROM t2021 t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."outputs") f
),

-- Identify transactions that have at least one output value appearing at least twice
has_dup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "hash", 1 AS "has_dup"
    FROM flattened
    GROUP BY "hash", "output_val"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),

-- Flag coinjoin transactions (all three conditions)
coinjoin_flag AS (
    SELECT
        t."hash",
        t."month",
        t."output_count",
        t."input_count",
        t."output_value",
        t."input_value",
        CASE
            WHEN t."output_count" > 2
             AND t."output_value" <= t."input_value"
             AND COALESCE(d."has_dup", 0) = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS "is_coinjoin"
    FROM t2021 t
    LEFT JOIN has_dup d ON t."hash" = d."hash"
)

-- Monthly aggregation
SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "month") AS "month",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM("is_coinjoin") / COUNT(*), 1) AS "pct_transactions",
    ROUND(
        0.5 * (
            100.0 * SUM("is_coinjoin" * "input_count") / NULLIF(SUM("input_count"), 0)
            + 100.0 * SUM("is_coinjoin" * "output_count") / NULLIF(SUM("output_count"), 0)
        ), 1
    ) AS "pct_utxos",
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "is_coinjoin" = 1 THEN "input_value" ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM("input_value"), 0), 1
    ) AS "pct_volume"
FROM coinjoin_flag
GROUP BY "month"
ORDER BY "pct_volume" DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH 
-- Get all outputs (credits) for April 2023
outputs_credits AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(o."addresses") > 1 
            THEN ARRAY_TO_STRING(o."addresses", ',')
            ELSE o."addresses"[0]::STRING
        END AS "address",
        SUM(o."value") AS "credit_amount"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."TRANSACTIONS" t
    JOIN "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."OUTPUTS" o
        ON t."hash" = o."transaction_hash"
    WHERE t."block_timestamp_month" = '2023-04-01'
    GROUP BY "address"
),
-- Get all inputs (debits) for April 2023
inputs_debits AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(i."addresses") > 1 
            THEN ARRAY_TO_STRING(i."addresses", ',')
            ELSE i."addresses"[0]::STRING
        END AS "address",
        SUM(i."value") AS "debit_amount"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."TRANSACTIONS" t
    JOIN "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_DASH"."INPUTS" i
        ON t."hash" = i."transaction_hash"
    WHERE t."block_timestamp_month" = '2023-04-01'
    GROUP BY "address"
),
-- Combine credits and debits per address
combined_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(c."address", d."address") AS "address",
        COALESCE(c."credit_amount", 0) - COALESCE(d."debit_amount", 0) AS "net_balance"
    FROM outputs_credits c
    FULL OUTER JOIN inputs_debits d
        ON c."address" = d."address"
)
-- Find highest and lowest net balance
SELECT 
    MAX("net_balance") AS "highest_balance",
    MIN("net_balance") AS "lowest_balance"
FROM combined_balances;
```
</details>

**Question**: What were the maximum and minimum net balance changes for Ethereum Classic addresses on October 14, 2016? Calculate these by summing all transactions where addresses received funds (debits), sent funds (credits), and paid or received gas fees. Only include successful status transactions and exclude internal calls of types. For gas fees, consider both the fees paid by transaction senders and received by miners, calculated as multiplied by the gas price for both miners and senders

**Status**: Baseline ❌ | SlayQL ❌

#### 📊 Execution Results Comparison

|-------------------------:|-------------------------:|
|                      nan |                      nan |

<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
-- Step 1: Filter transactions on October 14, 2016, with successful status
filtered_txns AS (
    SELECT
        "hash",
        "from_address",
        "to_address",
        "value",
        "gas_price",
        "receipt_gas_used",
        "receipt_status",
        "block_timestamp"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_ETHEREUM_CLASSIC"."TRANSACTIONS"
    WHERE
        -- October 14, 2016 in Unix microseconds: 1476489600000000 to 1476576000000000
        "block_timestamp" >= 1476489600000000
        AND "block_timestamp" < 1476576000000000
        AND "receipt_status" = 1
),

-- Step 2: Calculate net balance change per transaction for each address
-- For senders: they lose the transferred value + gas fee (paid)
-- For receivers: they gain the transferred value only
address_changes AS (
    -- Sender: negative value and negative gas fee
    SELECT
        "from_address" AS address,
        -("value" + ("receipt_gas_used" * "gas_price")) AS net_change
    FROM filtered_txns
    WHERE "from_address" IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- Receiver: positive value
    SELECT
        "to_address" AS address,
        "value" AS net_change
    FROM filtered_txns
    WHERE "to_address" IS NOT NULL
),

-- Step 3: Aggregate net changes per address
net_balance AS (
    SELECT
        address,
        SUM(net_change) AS net_balance_change
    FROM address_changes
    GROUP BY address
)

-- Step 4: Get maximum and minimum net balance changes
SELECT
    MAX(net_balance_change) AS max_net_balance_change,
    MIN(net_balance_change) AS min_net_balance_change
FROM net_balance;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH tx_outputs AS (
    SELECT 
        "hash",
        "block_timestamp_month",
        "output_count",
        "output_value",
        "input_value",
        "outputs"
    FROM "CRYPTO"."CRYPTO_BITCOIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
    WHERE "block_timestamp_month" >= '2023-07-01'
),

flat_outputs AS (
    SELECT 
        "hash",
        "block_timestamp_month",
        "output_count",
        "output_value",
        "input_value",
        f.value:"value"::NUMBER AS "output_value_single"
    FROM tx_outputs,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "outputs") f
),

duplicate_value_tx AS (
    SELECT 
        "hash",
        "block_timestamp_month",
        "output_count",
        "output_value",
        "input_value",
        COUNT(*) AS "output_cnt_per_value"
    FROM flat_outputs
    GROUP BY "hash", "block_timestamp_month", "output_count", "output_value", "input_value", "output_value_single"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),

coinjoin_tx AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "hash",
        "block_timestamp_month",
        "output_count",
        "output_value",
        "input_value"
    FROM duplicate_value_tx
    WHERE "output_count" > 2
      AND "output_value" <= "input_value"
),

monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        "block_timestamp_month" AS "month",
        COUNT(*) AS "total_tx",
        SUM("output_count") AS "total_utxos",
        SUM("input_value") AS "total_volume"
    FROM tx_outputs
    GROUP BY "block_timestamp_month"
),

monthly_coinjoin AS (
    SELECT 
        "block_timestamp_month" AS "month",
        COUNT(*) AS "cj_tx",
        SUM("output_count") AS "cj_utxos",
        SUM("input_value") AS "cj_volume"
    FROM coinjoin_tx
    GROUP BY "block_timestamp_month"
)

SELECT 
    t."month",
    ROUND(COALESCE(c."cj_tx", 0) / t."total_tx" * 100, 4) AS "tx_percentage",
    ROUND(COALESCE(c."cj_utxos", 0) / t."total_utxos" * 100, 4) AS "utxo_percentage",
    ROUND(COALESCE(c."cj_volume", 0) / t."total_volume" * 100, 4) AS "volume_percentage"
FROM monthly_totals t
LEFT JOIN monthly_coinjoin c ON t."month" = c."month"
ORDER BY t."month";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- ============================================================
-- Comprehensive Report of Ethereum Addresses Active Before 2017-01-01
-- All ETH values are divided by 10^18 (Wei -> Ether), rounded to 4 decimals.
-- Only addresses with at least one transaction/activity before 2017-01-01 are included.
-- ============================================================

WITH
    -- Step 1: Identify all addresses that were active before 2017-01-01
    active_addresses AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT "address"
        FROM (
            SELECT "from_address" AS "address"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL 
                AND "block_timestamp" / 1000000 < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01')
            UNION
            SELECT "to_address"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL 
                AND "block_timestamp" / 1000000 < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01')
            UNION
            SELECT "from_address"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL 
                AND "block_timestamp" / 1000000 < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01')
            UNION
            SELECT "to_address"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL 
                AND "block_timestamp" / 1000000 < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01')
            UNION
            SELECT "from_address"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL 
                AND "block_timestamp" / 1000000 < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01')
            UNION
            SELECT "to_address"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL 
                AND "block_timestamp" / 1000000 < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01')
        ) all_addresses
        WHERE "address" IS NOT NULL AND "address" != ''
    ),

    -- Step 2: Transaction fees paid by address (as sender)
    fees AS (
        SELECT
            t."from_address" AS "address",
            SUM(t."receipt_gas_used" * t."gas_price") AS "fees_wei"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS" t
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."from_address" = a."address"
        WHERE t."receipt_gas_used" IS NOT NULL AND t."gas_price" IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY t."from_address"
    ),

    -- Step 3: Incoming trace metrics (ETH transfers to address)
    trace_in AS (
        SELECT
            t."to_address" AS "address",
            SUM(t."value") AS "in_value",
            COUNT(*) AS "in_trace_count",
            COUNT(DISTINCT t."from_address") AS "in_addr_count",
            COUNT(CASE WHEN t."value" > 0 THEN 1 END) AS "in_transfer_count",
            AVG(t."value") AS "in_avg_amount",
            AVG(CASE WHEN t."trace_type" = 'call' THEN t."gas_used" END) AS "avg_gas_used",
            STDDEV(CASE WHEN t."trace_type" = 'call' THEN t."gas_used" END) AS "std_gas_used"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES" t
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."to_address" = a."address"
        WHERE (t."call_type" IS NULL OR t."call_type" NOT IN ('delegatecall','callcode','staticcall'))
          AND t."trace_type" NOT IN ('reward','genesis','daofork')
        GROUP BY t."to_address"
    ),

    -- Step 4: Outgoing trace metrics (ETH transfers from address)
    trace_out AS (
        SELECT
            t."from_address" AS "address",
            SUM(t."value") AS "out_value",
            COUNT(*) AS "out_trace_count",
            COUNT(DISTINCT t."to_address") AS "out_addr_count",
            COUNT(CASE WHEN t."value" > 0 THEN 1 END) AS "out_transfer_count",
            AVG(t."value") AS "out_avg_amount"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES" t
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."from_address" = a."address"
        WHERE (t."call_type" IS NULL OR t."call_type" NOT IN ('delegatecall','callcode','staticcall'))
          AND t."trace_type" NOT IN ('reward','genesis','daofork')
        GROUP BY t."from_address"
    ),

    -- Step 5: Hourly activity pattern
    hourly_r AS (
        SELECT
            "address",
            SQRT(POW(SUM(COS(2 * PI() * EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP("block_ts")) / 24)), 2) + 
                 POW(SUM(SIN(2 * PI() * EXTRACT(HOUR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP("block_ts")) / 24)), 2)) / 
            NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "R_active_hour"
        FROM (
            SELECT "from_address" AS "address", TO_TIMESTAMP("block_timestamp" / 1000000) AS "block_ts"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT "to_address" AS "address", TO_TIMESTAMP("block_timestamp" / 1000000) AS "block_ts"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL
        ) act
        GROUP BY "address"
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 24
    ),

    -- Step 6: Active days (distinct calendar days from all transactions)
    active_days AS (
        SELECT
            "address",
            COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(TO_TIMESTAMP("block_timestamp" / 1000000))) AS "active_days"
        FROM (
            SELECT "from_address" AS "address", "block_timestamp"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT "to_address" AS "address", "block_timestamp"
            FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS"
            WHERE "block_timestamp" IS NOT NULL
        ) act
        GROUP BY "address"
    ),

    -- Step 7 & 8: Token transfers
    token_in AS (
        SELECT
            tt."to_address" AS "address",
            COUNT(*) AS "token_in_tnx",
            COUNT(DISTINCT tt."token_address") AS "token_in_type",
            COUNT(DISTINCT tt."from_address") AS "token_from_addr"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS" tt
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON tt."to_address" = a."address"
        GROUP BY tt."to_address"
    ),

    token_out AS (
        SELECT
            tt."from_address" AS "address",
            COUNT(*) AS "token_out_tnx",
            COUNT(DISTINCT tt."token_address") AS "token_out_type",
            COUNT(DISTINCT tt."to_address") AS "token_to_addr"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TOKEN_TRANSFERS" tt
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON tt."from_address" = a."address"
        GROUP BY tt."from_address"
    ),

    -- Step 9: Mining rewards
    rewards AS (
        SELECT
            t."to_address" AS "address",
            SUM(t."value") AS "reward_wei"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES" t
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."to_address" = a."address"
        WHERE t."trace_type" = 'reward' AND t."value" IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY t."to_address"
    ),

    -- Step 10: Contract creation count
    contracts_created AS (
        SELECT
            t."from_address" AS "address",
            COUNT(*) AS "contract_create_count"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES" t
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."from_address" = a."address"
        WHERE t."trace_type" = 'create'
        GROUP BY t."from_address"
    ),

    -- Step 11: Failed transaction count
    -- receipt_status: 0 = failure, 1 = success
    failures AS (
        SELECT
            t."from_address" AS "address",
            COUNT(*) AS "failure_count"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRANSACTIONS" t
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."from_address" = a."address"
        WHERE t."receipt_status" = 0
        GROUP BY t."from_address"
    ),

    -- Step 12: Bytecode size of contracts created by the address
    bytecode AS (
        SELECT
            t."from_address" AS "address",
            SUM(LENGTH(c."bytecode")) AS "bytecode_size"
        FROM "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."TRACES" t
        INNER JOIN "ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."ETHEREUM_BLOCKCHAIN"."CONTRACTS" c
            ON t."to_address" = c."address"
        INNER JOIN active_addresses a ON t."from_address" = a."address"
        WHERE t."trace_type" = 'create'
        GROUP BY t."from_address"
    )

-- Final report: left join all metrics to the active addresses
SELECT
    a."address" AS "address",
    ROUND((COALESCE(ti."in_value", 0) - COALESCE(to2."out_value", 0) - COALESCE(f."fees_wei", 0)) / 1e18, 4) AS "balance",
    hr."R_active_hour" AS "R_active_hour",
    ad."active_days" AS "active_days",
    COALESCE(ti."in_trace_count", 0) AS "in_trace_count",
    COALESCE(ti."in_addr_count", 0) AS "in_addr_count",
    COALESCE(ti."in_transfer_count", 0) AS "in_transfer_count",
    ROUND(COALESCE(ti."in_avg_amount", 0) / 1e18, 4) AS "in_avg_amount",
    ROUND(COALESCE(ti."avg_gas_used", 0), 4) AS "avg_gas_used",
    ROUND(COALESCE(ti."std_gas_used", 0), 4) AS "std_gas_used",
    COALESCE(to2."out_trace_count", 0) AS "out_trace_count",
    COALESCE(to2."out_addr_count", 0) AS "out_addr_count",
    COALESCE(to2."out_transfer_count", 0) AS "out_transfer_count",
    ROUND(COALESCE(to2."out_avg_amount", 0) / 1e18, 4) AS "out_avg_amount",
    COALESCE(tkn_in."token_in_tnx", 0) AS "token_in_tnx",
    COALESCE(tkn_in."token_in_type", 0) AS "token_in_type",
    COALESCE(tkn_in."token_from_addr", 0) AS "token_from_addr",
    COALESCE(tkn_out."token_out_tnx", 0) AS "token_out_tnx",
    COALESCE(tkn_out."token_out_type", 0) AS "token_out_type",
    COALESCE(tkn_out."token_to_addr", 0) AS "token_to_addr",
    ROUND(COALESCE(r."reward_wei", 0) / 1e18, 4) AS "reward_amount",
    COALESCE(cc."contract_create_count", 0) AS "contract_create_count",
    COALESCE(fail."failure_count", 0) AS "failure_count",
    COALESCE(bc."bytecode_size", 0) AS "bytecode_size"
FROM active_addresses a
LEFT JOIN trace_in ti ON a."address" = ti."address"
LEFT JOIN trace_out to2 ON a."address" = to2."address"
LEFT JOIN fees f ON a."address" = f."address"
LEFT JOIN hourly_r hr ON a."address" = hr."address"
LEFT JOIN active_days ad ON a."address" = ad."address"
LEFT JOIN token_in tkn_in ON a."address" = tkn_in."address"
LEFT JOIN token_out tkn_out ON a."address" = tkn_out."address"
LEFT JOIN rewards r ON a."address" = r."address"
LEFT JOIN contracts_created cc ON a."address" = cc."address"
LEFT JOIN failures fail ON a."address" = fail."address"
LEFT JOIN bytecode bc ON a."address" = bc."address"
ORDER BY a."address";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH station_data AS (
  -- Gather data for 2013-2016 for the specified station, only validated rows
  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2013`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846' AND qflag IS NULL AND value IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2014`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846' AND qflag IS NULL AND value IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2015`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846' AND qflag IS NULL AND value IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT id, date, element, value, qflag
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846' AND qflag IS NULL AND value IS NOT NULL
),

last_15_days AS (
  -- Identify the last 15 days of each year (2013 to 2016)
  SELECT
    id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    MAX(date) AS last_date_of_year
  FROM station_data
  GROUP BY id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
)

-- Now compute the highest PRCP, TMIN, TMAX in those last 15 days
SELECT
  l.year,
  -- PRCP max (convert from tenths of mm to mm)
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.element = 'PRCP' THEN s.value / 10.0 END) AS max_precipitation_mm,
  -- TMIN max (convert from tenths of °C to °C)
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.element = 'TMIN' THEN s.value / 10.0 END) AS max_tmin_celsius,
  -- TMAX max
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.element = 'TMAX' THEN s.value / 10.0 END) AS max_tmax_celsius
FROM last_15_days l
JOIN station_data s
  ON s.id = l.id
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = l.year
  AND s.date >= DATE_SUB(l.last_date_of_year, INTERVAL 14 DAY)  -- last 15 days inclusive
  AND s.date <= l.last_date_of_year
GROUP BY l.year
ORDER BY l.year;
```
</details>

N/A

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Identify trips that start and end at the same station (self-loop trips)
WITH self_loop AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id AS station_id,
    starttime,
    -- Use LAG and LEAD to get adjacent trips' start times within the same station
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) AS prev_starttime,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) AS next_starttime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),

-- Step 2: Flag each self-loop trip as a group ride if it is within 2 minutes of an adjacent trip
group_rides_flag AS (
  SELECT 
    station_id,
    -- A trip is a group ride if either the previous or next trip's start time is within 120 seconds
    CASE 
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_starttime, SECOND) <= 120 
        OR TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_starttime, starttime, SECOND) <= 120 
      THEN 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END AS is_group
  FROM self_loop
),

-- Step 3: Count group rides per station
station_group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    station_id,
    COUNT(*) AS group_trip_count
  FROM group_rides_flag
  WHERE is_group = 1
  GROUP BY station_id
),

-- Step 4: Count total trips ending at each station (denominator)
station_total_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id AS station_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trips_ending
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
)

-- Step 5: Combine, compute proportion, and get top 10 stations
SELECT 
  stt.station_id,
  st.name AS station_name,
  COALESCE(sgc.group_trip_count, 0) AS group_trip_count,
  stt.total_trips_ending,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sgc.group_trip_count, 0) / stt.total_trips_ending, 4) AS proportion
FROM station_total_trips stt
LEFT JOIN station_group_counts sgc ON stt.station_id = sgc.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` st 
  ON CAST(stt.station_id AS STRING) = st.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Calculate change in living trees per fall color in NYC from 1995 to 2015
WITH 
-- Count trees NOT marked as dead in 1995 census
trees_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    -- Include trees where status is NULL, 'Good', 'Poor' etc. but not 'Dead'
    AND (status IS NULL OR UPPER(status) != 'DEAD')
  GROUP BY species_name
),

-- Count trees alive in 2015 census
trees_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS species_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
    AND UPPER(status) = 'ALIVE'
  GROUP BY species_name
),

-- Calculate difference per species
species_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(t1995.species_name, t2015.species_name) AS species_name,
    COALESCE(t1995.cnt_1995, 0) - COALESCE(t2015.cnt_2015, 0) AS diff
  FROM trees_1995 t1995
  FULL OUTER JOIN trees_2015 t2015
    ON t1995.species_name = t2015.species_name
)

-- Group by fall_color and sum differences
SELECT 
  ts.fall_color,
  SUM(sd.diff) AS total_change
FROM species_diff sd
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts
  ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = sd.species_name
WHERE ts.fall_color IS NOT NULL AND ts.fall_color != ''
GROUP BY ts.fall_color
ORDER BY total_change DESC;
```
</details>

<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Aggregate 1995 census data by species
year_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS common_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_1995,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Dead') AS dead_1995,
    COUNTIF(status != 'Dead' AND status IS NOT NULL) AS alive_1995
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY latin_name
),

-- Aggregate 2015 census data by species
year_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS common_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_2015,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Dead') AS dead_2015,
    COUNTIF(status != 'Dead' AND status IS NOT NULL) AS alive_2015
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY latin_name
)

-- Final query combining both years with growth calculations
SELECT 
  COALESCE(y95.latin_name, y15.latin_name) AS latin_name,
  COALESCE(y95.common_name, y15.common_name) AS common_name,
  COALESCE(y95.total_1995, 0) AS total_1995,
  COALESCE(y95.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_1995,
  COALESCE(y95.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_1995,
  COALESCE(y15.total_2015, 0) AS total_2015,
  COALESCE(y15.alive_2015, 0) AS alive_2015,
  COALESCE(y15.dead_2015, 0) AS dead_2015,
  COALESCE(y15.total_2015, 0) - COALESCE(y95.total_1995, 0) AS total_growth,
  COALESCE(y15.alive_2015, 0) - COALESCE(y95.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_growth,
  COALESCE(y15.dead_2015, 0) - COALESCE(y95.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_growth
FROM year_1995 y95
FULL OUTER JOIN year_2015 y15 
  ON y95.latin_name = y15.latin_name
WHERE COALESCE(y95.latin_name, y15.latin_name) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
GROUP BY day_of_week, hour_of_day
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
```

```sql
        dropoff_location_id,
        TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, MINUTE) AS trip_duration_minutes
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE 
        -- Date range: February 1-7, 2016 inclusive
        pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-02-01 00:00:00')
        AND pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-02-08 00:00:00')
        -- Positive trip duration
        AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
        -- More than 3 passengers
        AND passenger_count > 3
        -- Trip distance at least 10 miles
        AND trip_distance >= 10.0
),
-- Identify all taxi zones in Brooklyn
brooklyn_zones AS (
    SELECT zone_id
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom`
    WHERE LOWER(borough) = 'brooklyn'
)
-- Compute the average trip duration
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(td.trip_duration_minutes), 4) AS avg_trip_duration_minutes
FROM trip_durations td
-- Both pickup and dropoff must be in Brooklyn
INNER JOIN brooklyn_zones pickup_br 
    ON td.pickup_location_id = pickup_br.zone_id
INNER JOIN brooklyn_zones dropoff_br 
    ON td.dropoff_location_id = dropoff_br.zone_id
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Filter trips based on all criteria
filtered_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        pickup_location_id,
        dropoff_location_id,
        pickup_datetime,
        dropoff_datetime,
        passenger_count,
        trip_distance,
        tip_amount,
        tolls_amount,
        mta_tax,
        fare_amount,
        total_amount
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE 
        -- Date filter: Jan 1-7, 2016
        pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' 
        AND pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08 00:00:00'
        -- Valid timestamps
        AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
        -- Passenger count > 0
        AND passenger_count > 0
        -- All amounts non-negative
        AND trip_distance >= 0
        AND tip_amount >= 0
        AND tolls_amount >= 0
        AND mta_tax >= 0
        AND fare_amount >= 0
        AND total_amount >= 0
),

-- Step 2: Join with taxi zones to get borough information
trips_with_borough AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.*,
        tz.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
        tz.borough AS pickup_borough
    FROM filtered_trips ft
    LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
        ON CAST(ft.pickup_location_id AS STRING) = tz.zone_id
    WHERE 
        -- Exclude EWR and Staten Island
        tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
        AND tz.borough IS NOT NULL
),

-- Step 3: Calculate tip rate and categorize
tip_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        pickup_borough,
        CASE 
            -- Handle edge case where total_amount is 0
            WHEN total_amount = 0 OR tip_amount = 0 THEN '0% (no tip)'
            ELSE
                CASE 
                    WHEN ROUND((tip_amount / (total_amount - tip_amount)) * 100, 2) <= 5 THEN 'up to 5%'
                    WHEN ROUND((tip_amount / (total_amount - tip_amount)) * 100, 2) <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
                    WHEN ROUND((tip_amount / (total_amount - tip_amount)) * 100, 2) <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
                    WHEN ROUND((tip_amount / (total_amount - tip_amount)) * 100, 2) <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
                    WHEN ROUND((tip_amount / (total_amount - tip_amount)) * 100, 2) <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
                    ELSE 'More than 25%'
                END
        END AS tip_category
    FROM trips_with_borough
),

-- Step 4: Count trips per borough per category
borough_category_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        pickup_borough,
        tip_category,
        COUNT(*) AS category_count
    FROM tip_categories
    WHERE tip_category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),

-- Step 5: Get total trips per borough
borough_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pickup_borough,
        SUM(category_count) AS total_trips
    FROM borough_category_counts
    GROUP BY pickup_borough
)

-- Final: Calculate proportions
SELECT 
    bcc.pickup_borough,
    bcc.tip_category,
    ROUND(bcc.category_count * 100.0 / bt.total_trips, 4) AS proportion_percent
FROM borough_category_counts bcc
JOIN borough_totals bt 
    ON bcc.pickup_borough = bt.pickup_borough
ORDER BY 
    pickup_borough, 
    CASE tip_category
        WHEN '0% (no tip)' THEN 1
        WHEN 'up to 5%' THEN 2
        WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
        WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
        WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
        WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
        WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
    END;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH 
-- Total stations per borough
total_stations AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_name) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),

-- Stations that have at least one entrance that is both entry and ADA-compliant
stations_with_ada_entry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.borough_name,
    s.station_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE
    AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
),

-- Count those stations per borough
qualified_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_name) AS ada_entry_stations
  FROM stations_with_ada_entry
  GROUP BY borough_name
)

-- Final output: join, compute percentage, sort
SELECT 
  t.borough_name,
  t.total_stations,
  COALESCE(q.ada_entry_stations, 0) AS ada_entry_stations,
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(q.ada_entry_stations, 0) * 100.0 / t.total_stations, 
    4
  ) AS percentage
FROM total_stations t
LEFT JOIN qualified_counts q
  ON t.borough_name = q.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC;
```

```sql
-- Calculate total distance (in meters) traveled by each bike in San Francisco Bikeshare
-- using station coordinates to compute great-circle distance per trip

WITH trip_distances AS (
  -- For each trip, compute the straight-line distance between start and end stations
  SELECT
    t.bike_number,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(s_start.longitude, s_start.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(s_end.longitude, s_end.latitude)
    ) AS distance_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_start
    ON t.start_station_id = s_start.station_id
  INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_end
    ON t.end_station_id = s_end.station_id
)
-- Aggregate total distance per bike and round to 4 decimal places
SELECT
  bike_number,
  ROUND(SUM(distance_meters), 4) AS total_distance_meters
FROM trip_distances
GROUP BY bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC;
```
</details>

```sql
-- Step 1: Compute year-month and duration in minutes for each trip
WITH trips AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS yearmonth,
    start_date,
    duration_sec / 60.0 AS duration_min
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)

-- Step 2: For each year-month, get first, last, highest, and lowest trip durations
SELECT
  yearmonth,
  ROUND(ARRAY_AGG(duration_min ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)], 4) AS first_trip_duration_min,
  ROUND(ARRAY_AGG(duration_min ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)], 4) AS last_trip_duration_min,
  ROUND(MAX(duration_min), 4) AS highest_trip_duration_min,
  ROUND(MIN(duration_min), 4) AS lowest_trip_duration_min
FROM trips
GROUP BY yearmonth
ORDER BY yearmonth;
```
</details>

```sql
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
        ON CAST(t.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017
),
ranked_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        twr.trip_id,
        twr.duration_seconds AS ride_duration,
        twr.start_date AS start_time,
        twr.start_station_name AS starting_station,
        twr.member_gender,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY twr.region_id ORDER BY twr.start_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM trip_with_region twr
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r
        ON twr.region_id = r.region_id
)
SELECT 
    region_name,
    trip_id,
    ride_duration,
    start_time,
    starting_station,
    member_gender
FROM ranked_trips
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH filtered_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        t."trip_id",
        t."duration_sec",
        TO_TIMESTAMP(t."start_date" / 1000000) AS "start_date",
        t."start_station_name",
        t."end_station_name",
        t."bike_number",
        t."subscriber_type",
        t."member_birth_year",
        t."member_gender",
        t."start_station_id"
    FROM "SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS"."SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_TRIPS" t
    WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(t."start_date" / 1000000) >= '2017-07-01'
        AND TO_TIMESTAMP(t."start_date" / 1000000) <= '2017-12-31'
        AND t."start_station_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND t."member_birth_year" IS NOT NULL
        AND t."member_birth_year" = t."member_birth_year"   -- Exclude NaN (NaN != NaN)
        AND t."member_gender" IS NOT NULL
        AND t."member_gender" != 'None'
)
SELECT 
    ft."trip_id",
    ft."duration_sec",
    ft."start_date",
    ft."start_station_name",
    CONCAT(ft."start_station_name", ' - ', ft."end_station_name") AS "route",
    ft."bike_number",
    ft."subscriber_type",
    ft."member_birth_year",
    YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CAST(ft."member_birth_year" AS INTEGER) AS "current_age",
    CASE 
        WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CAST(ft."member_birth_year" AS INTEGER) < 40 THEN 'Young (<40 Y.O)'
        WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CAST(ft."member_birth_year" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 60 THEN 'Adult (40-60 Y.O)'
        ELSE 'Senior Adult (>60 Y.O)'
    END AS "age_classification",
    ft."member_gender",
    r."name" AS "region_name"
FROM filtered_trips ft
LEFT JOIN "SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS"."SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO" si
    ON ft."start_station_id" = CAST(si."station_id" AS NUMBER)
LEFT JOIN "SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS"."SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE"."BIKESHARE_REGIONS" r
    ON si."region_id" = r."region_id"
ORDER BY ft."duration_sec" DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

### 78. bq339 (DB: `san_francisco_plus`)
**Question**: Which month in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes for customers and subscribers?	Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data?

**Status**: Baseline ❌ | SlayQL ❌

#### 📊 Execution Results Comparison

<details open>
<summary><b>Gold Standard Result (Expected)</b></summary>

|   month |
|--------:|
|       9 |

<details open>
<summary><b>SlayQL Execution Result (❌)</b></summary>

|   month |
|--------:|
|       7 |

</details>

<details open>
<summary><b>Baseline Execution Result (❌)</b></summary>

N/A

</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Compute total bike usage minutes per month and per subscriber type for 2017
WITH monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
  GROUP BY month, subscriber_type
),

-- Step 2: Pivot the data so each month has one row with columns for Subscriber and Customer minutes
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes
  FROM monthly_totals
  GROUP BY month
)

-- Step 3: Compute absolute difference in thousands of minutes and find the month with the largest value
SELECT
  month
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY ABS(subscriber_minutes - customer_minutes) / 1000.0 DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH clay_stop AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stops`

),

sacramento_stop AS (

  WHERE stop_name = 'Sacramento St & Davis St'
),

trips_with_both_stops AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(clay.trip_id AS STRING) AS trip_id,
    clay.stop_sequence AS clay_sequence,
    sac.stop_sequence AS sacramento_sequence,
    clay.departure_time AS clay_departure,
    sac.arrival_time AS sacramento_arrival
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` clay
  CROSS JOIN clay_stop cs
  CROSS JOIN sacramento_stop ss
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` sac
    ON clay.trip_id = sac.trip_id
  WHERE CAST(clay.stop_id AS STRING) = cs.stop_id
    AND CAST(sac.stop_id AS STRING) = ss.stop_id
    AND clay.stop_sequence < sac.stop_sequence
)

SELECT 
  FORMAT_TIME('%H:%M:%S', t.clay_departure) AS earliest_departure_from_clay,
  FORMAT_TIME('%H:%M:%S', t.sacramento_arrival) AS latest_arrival_at_sacramento,
  tr.trip_headsign,
  tr.route_id
FROM trips_with_both_stops t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` tr
  ON t.trip_id = tr.trip_id
ORDER BY tr.route_id, tr.trip_headsign;
```

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: CTE to associate each bike share station with its neighborhood via spatial join
WITH station_neighborhood AS (
    SELECT
        n.neighborhood AS neighborhood,
        s.station_id AS station_id
    FROM
        `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` n
    INNER JOIN
        `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON
        ST_WITHIN(s.station_geom, n.neighborhood_geom)
),

-- Step 2: CTE to associate each crime incident with its neighborhood via spatial join
incident_neighborhood AS (
    SELECT
        n.neighborhood AS neighborhood,
        i.unique_key AS incident_id
    FROM
        `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` n
    INNER JOIN
        `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
    ON
        ST_WITHIN(SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(i.location), n.neighborhood_geom)
    WHERE
        i.location IS NOT NULL
        AND SAFE.ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(i.location) IS NOT NULL
)

-- Final query: aggregate counts per neighborhood and keep only those with both stations and incidents
SELECT
    n.neighborhood,
    COALESCE(sc.station_count, 0) AS total_bike_share_stations,
    COALESCE(ic.incident_count, 0) AS total_crime_incidents
FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` n
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        neighborhood,
        COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS station_count
    FROM
        station_neighborhood
    GROUP BY
        neighborhood
) sc
ON
    n.neighborhood = sc.neighborhood
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        neighborhood,
        COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) AS incident_count
    FROM
        incident_neighborhood
    GROUP BY
        neighborhood
) ic
ON
    n.neighborhood = ic.neighborhood
WHERE
    sc.station_count > 0
    AND ic.incident_count > 0
ORDER BY
    n.neighborhood;
```
</details>

### 81. sf_bq014 (DB: `THELOOK_ECOMMERCE`)
**Question**: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order?

**Status**: Baseline ❌ | SlayQL ❌

#### 📊 Execution Results Comparison

<summary><b>Gold Standard Result (Expected)</b></summary>

|----------------:|
|          332465 |

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
N/A
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Identify each user's first order that is not cancelled and not returned
WITH first_successful_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o."user_id",
        o."order_id",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o."user_id" 
            ORDER BY o."created_at" ASC
        ) AS "rn"
    FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDERS" o
    WHERE 
        o."status" != 'Cancelled'
        AND o."returned_at" IS NULL
),
-- Step 2: Get all categories purchased in those first orders (allow duplicates per user per category)
first_order_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fo."user_id",
        p."category"
    FROM first_successful_orders fo
    JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" oi
        ON fo."order_id" = oi."order_id"
    JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" p
        ON oi."product_id" = p."id"
    WHERE fo."rn" = 1
),
-- Step 3: Count distinct customers per category and rank to find top category
category_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        foc."category",
        COUNT(DISTINCT foc."user_id") AS "customer_count"
    FROM first_order_categories foc
    GROUP BY foc."category"
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        cc."category",
        cc."customer_count",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cc."customer_count" DESC) AS "rnk"
    FROM category_customer_counts cc
),
top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        rc."category"
    FROM ranked_categories rc
    WHERE rc."rnk" = 1
)
-- Step 4: Compute total revenue for that category from all non-cancelled, non-returned orders/items
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(oi."sale_price"), 4) AS "total_revenue"
FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."ORDER_ITEMS" oi
JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" p
    ON oi."product_id" = p."id"
JOIN top_category tc
    ON p."category" = tc."category"
WHERE 
    oi."status" != 'Cancelled'
    AND oi."returned_at" IS NULL;
```
</details>

```sql
product_page_events AS (

        e."session_id",
        e."created_at",
        LEAD(e."created_at") OVER (
            PARTITION BY e."session_id"
            ORDER BY e."created_at"
        ) AS "next_event_time",
        p."category"
    FROM "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."EVENTS" e
    INNER JOIN "THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."THELOOK_ECOMMERCE"."PRODUCTS" p
        ON CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(e."uri", '/product/(\\d+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1) AS INTEGER) = p."id"
    WHERE e."event_type" = 'product'
)
SELECT
    tc."category",
    ROUND(AVG((ppe."next_event_time" - ppe."created_at") / 60000000.0), 4) AS "avg_minutes_on_page"
FROM top_category tc
INNER JOIN product_page_events ppe
    ON tc."category" = ppe."category"
WHERE ppe."next_event_time" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tc."category";
```
